reviews.title: Charged After Canceling My Free Trial
reviews.text:
Very disappointed with CamToPlan. My free trial was supposed to end on the 27th, and I made sure to cancel my subscription before that date specifically to avoid being charged. Despite canceling on time, I was still charged for a subscription I never intended to purchase.

What is the point of offering a free trial with the option to cancel if customers are still going to be charged after canceling? This is extremely frustrating and feels unfair. I followed the cancellation process and should not have been billed.

I expect a full refund and an explanation for why I was charged after canceling. Be careful when signing up for this app’s free trial, and double-check your subscriptions and billing statements.
